answer: A wharf sponsor vouches for each new identity: an operator locks 70 credits and signs the newcomer into the wharf book. The newcomer must sail one ocean voyage with a vine-sealed manifest for auditors to re-weigh and replay. A caught fake burns the bond and halves the sponsor's slots, so rented sponsors fail. The k-th fake pays 100 plus 25 per decayed slot, so 1,000 fakes cost 12,587,500 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 30 once.
